in_hebrew.name: Thalassina
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Thalassina הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Thalassina refers to a sea goddess. This name is rooted in the Greek word 'thalassa' meaning 'sea'. As a Christian name, it represents the divine power and protection of the sea.
